description: This file defines the CalendarSyncJobManager class responsible for managing calendar synchronization jobs within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods to check if account-level or meeting-level sync jobs are active and interacts with job status helpers and database beans.

classes.name: CalendarSyncJobManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing calendar synchronization jobs, including checking if account and meeting jobs are active.

methods.name: accountJobIsActive
methods.description: Checks whether an account-level synchronization job is currently active for a given calendar account ID.

methods.name: getActiveMeetingJobCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active meeting synchronization jobs for a specific CalendarSyncOperation.

methods.name: meetingJobIsActive
methods.description: Determines if a meeting sync job is active based on the count of active meeting jobs.
